title: Hosts and Space owners hear when someone joins or follows

source.ref: Unwired-things scan 2026-11-18 (project thread: Verify every feature path end to end); owner: full approval to make it all right

detail:
Joining a Circle or following a Space told nobody. Owner ruling 2026-11-18: a bell notice under Updates and messages. A community.joined registry row (lifecycle, in-app) now fires from joinCircleAsMember to the Circle's host and from followSpace (new follows only) to the Space owner, never to the actor. The Lifecycle in-app switch is now wired and shows in settings; the wired.ts test pin moved with Daniel's go-ahead on the same card.

DONE 2026-11-18.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
